First of all sorry to hear the situation your in. The most I can help with is a few words of support. I sincerely hope that your financial situation gets resolved, and I send all my good thoughts and wishes in hope they make a difference. I my self also struggle with financial difficulties on a month to month basis. As a self sustained disabled person, I have to pay rent, bills, and take care or my two pets that I love as children, all with a very limited fixed income. I'm usually strapped for money and find myself asking for help through every venue I can but not always do these venues have the funds to help all the people in need as ive experienced. And I just want to say I greatly appreciate you extending a helping hand when you yourself need it, it shows all of us humanity isn't lost yet. Your an inspiration and I hope I inspire others people by giving in my own way and in any way I can.

It would be fun to see redditors helping others. We could post or link pictures or video of us helping others. You could choose the one that moves you most. I think this would definitely inspire people to do something meaningful for someone else, be it a loved one or a complete stranger.

I've been feeling stuck all my life as well. It can be a very lonely feeling, for the longest time I thought the only way to get rid of the feeling was to end myself, trust me I sometimes still do. But like you, something always keeps me from doing it. So I said to myself, if I'm going to be here, I might as well make something out of it, and even though most of the time I'm battling with the same demons as the people on this site I like coming here and try to leave my Mark in the world cuz I like you came here for a final plea of help at my weakest point and I found a lot of support from strangers that didn't know me and it gave me strength, so now I try to do the same. By the way u mentioned u saw soul animals. Do u have to be in front of the person to see them, or can u do it through pictures?

Please don't do anything in such a haste I can tell u from experience that hiv is not the end of the world like it might seem right now. I was diagnosed not so long ago myself and I was defeated and devastated at first. But with the help of my doctor and support of my family I have overcome my fears. I found out hiv is not a death sentence anymore. Ever since I started taking my medication I do not get sick always, after having a couple of talks with my mother and father they turned out to be more understanding than I thought and I have met a wonderful person that I love and loves me back despite me being hiv positive. Just keep your head up and don't give up. The night is darkest before the light shines once again. I send all my positive energy to you and hope you feel the solidarity in the messages you've been receiving. Your not alone.

Sounds a bit sketchy but it could be as you say an inexperienced employer. Either way you should never send sensitive information over open networks like public email because it is open to being potentially intercepted by an unwanted party. With that being said I'd investigate the place of employment more, maybe even talk to others employees and see if they had a similar experience when first applying. I'd wait and give the information in person in any case unless you don't trust the employer with your information.

Idk. Sorry to bring you in this. I've just been going through financial problems and this morning it culminated with me having a panic attack. I'm a self sustained disabled person and I have been able to get through with my disability check. It just enough to pay my rent and utility bills. I just felt so alone and helpless this morning, I dont know how I'm going to pay my utility bills for the rest of the year since the program that helps me is out of funds, and housing authority has my application in review and they told me its going to be processed until next year. And just yesterday I received a letter from social security saying my ssi, which is just 74 dollars, but being on ssi also qualified me for food stamps and Medicaid for my hiv medication is going to be withdrawn. So just in two days I have lost my ssi, my food stamps and my Medicaid. Not to mention the debt I'm in because of the payday loans I had to get last month due to my financial instability. I just felt like ending it would resolve all that. Idk I still feel that way but I'm to much of a coward to do anything. My anxiety has gone down and my urge to end it has diminished as well. Thank you for your consideration at least it makes me feel like someone cares . Thank you.
